questions.question: Which of the following functions cannot be frequency response of a discrete-time LTI system?
The signal $x[n]=1+\sin (n)+\sin (\pi n)$ is given as input to a low pass filter with cut-off frequency of 2 which gives the output signal $y[n]$. Select the correct statement from the following:
When the signal $x[n]=\sin (\omega_o n)$ is given as input to a filter, the output is zero. Select the correct statement from the following:

answers.a: If the system is a high pass filter, it will give zero output when the input is $x[n]=\sin (\omega_o / 2 n)$
answers.b: If the system is a low pass filter, it will give zero output when the input is $x[n]=\sin (2 \omega_o n)$
answers.c: If the system is a band pass filter, it will give zero output when the input is $x[n]=\sin (\omega_o / 2 n)$

questions.question: If the magnitude response of an LTI system is constant and the phase response is linear, then the input and output are related by

answers.a: output signal is a scaled and delayed version of the input signal
answers.b: output signal is always a scaled version of the input signal
answers.c: output signal is always a delayed version of the input signal

questions.question: If the input to an LTI system is $x[n]=e^{j n}$, the system output

answers.a: is always of the form $y[n]=A e^{j n}$
answers.b: is always of the form $y[n]=e^{j n}$
answers.c: is always of the form $y[n]=A e^{j n+j \phi}$
